BRIDGES_PT_25K contains center point locations of bridges along roads. It does not include bridges along Unmaintained Roads.

Distributed from GeoYukon by the Government of Yukon. Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.

BRIDGES_PT_25K contient les points centraux des ponts situés le long des routes. Cela n'inclut pas les ponts le long des routes non entretenues.
